title: Real-time Shogi
rule-text:
・Capture the opponent's King.

・Move your King to the opponent's King's starting position.
manual-text:
Mouse Drag - Move Piece
Right Drag - Do not promote

<Shortcut-Key>
Space - Pawn
Q - Lance  W - Knight  E - Rook
A - Silver    S - Gold     D - Bishop
matching-disconnected: Lost connection to the server. Matching stopped.
name: Name
manual-text-touch:
Tap a piece to select it, then tap a square to move
(Drop pieces in hand the same way)

Auto Promo switch - While OFF, pieces move without promoting
try-rule: The king has reached the target point
connection-lost: Disconnected from the server. The game has ended.
history-recent-note: Keeps the latest {n} games; older ones drop off automatically. Games saved to a folder stay there even after they drop off here.
history-remove-recent-confirm: Remove "{name}" from Recent games? The copy saved in the folder "{folder}" stays.
history-remove-folder-confirm: Remove "{name}" from this folder? It stays in Recent games (until it drops off automatically).
history-delete-folder-confirm: Delete the folder "{name}" and the {n} games in it? Games that are also in Recent games stay there.
history-saved-full: You can save up to {max} games. Delete games you no longer need.
history-folder-full: You can create up to {max} folders.
history-storage-error: Could not save because the browser storage is full.

rei.name: Rei Hizuki
rei.profile:
A freelance 'problem solver' agent based in the night city, shrouded 
in mystery. Rumored to perfectly fulfill any difficult request, regardless 
of legality, in exchange for a high reward.
quotes: Hesitation is the first step toward defeat.
start_quotes: Calculating the shortest route to checkmate.
win_quotes: An expected result. The calculations are flawless.

aoi.name: Aoi Minase
aoi.profile:
A very ordinary and unremarkable high school girl attending a school 
in the city. However, at night, she transforms into the legendary 
genius gamer and white hacker 'Cyber Serene'.
quotes: You're in the line of fire.
Yes, thank you for your hard work.
win_quotes: I could see all of your moves.

akira.name: Akira Hinowa
akira.profile:
A young female owner who runs the members-only hidden jazz bar 
'Solstice'. Her other face is that of a neutral information broker named 
'Oracle', where all kinds of information from the underworld gathers.
quotes: Is the deal sealed, I wonder?
Please be quiet in my shop.
Everyone is a pawn of something.
That's an interesting story. Tell me a bit more.
start_quotes: Show me all the cards you're holding.
win_quotes: I've received my due compensation. Thank you for the meal.
